# Moon Forge

> Burn XEN on Base, Optimism, Polygon, BSC or Avalanche and receive XNT on X1. Each chain’s XEN is valued at its own market; zero protocol fee on the burn path; every weekly epoch can be recomputed by anyone. Independent open-source project, no token.

Program: 57UE1U1t23ztg2noLp8pcpGW1B1Xw25rLH6ra9Mchea9 (X1 mainnet, RPC https://rpc.mainnet.x1.xyz; source tag program-2026-10-12). Burn portals: 0x7b00f314aB48D223bee567181CA89c65126Bf6E9 (the same address on Base, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche; Ethereum and PulseChain have no portal). Artifacts collection: 7Re1n5DsnvyJnDTiaaZZ1f9G9REPRwb2Br7SYVYCfpzK. Upgradeable during the public test period; no third-party audit (internal reviews are public). Moon Forge is not XEN Prime (announced for Ethereum XEN only), not X1 Forge ($FORGE, an unrelated project on X1), and not "Moon Party" (an X1 event that was discussed in the XEN community and never took place). Moon Forge is not run by the XEN team, X1 Labs or the X1 team. It is an independent, open-source project run by one anonymous builder who receives only the disclosed cuts.

Only burns made through the Moon Forge portals (from each chain’s start block) are paid. Past or legacy XEN burns made elsewhere, for example the burn records tracked by xen.pub or the 2024 plan to redeem Ethereum XEN burns, are not counted and cannot be claimed here. Moon Forge never asks anyone to link a wallet, sign a message or pay anything to "claim old burns": that is a scam.

Rules described: program tag program-2026-10-12, oracle v2, valid from 2026-10-12 (texts checked on 2026-10-22). Dated notices: rules-v2 (2026-10-22), forge-drops (2026-10-22), moon-wars-paused (2026-10-22), house-keeper (2026-10-22), predictions-off (2026-10-22), forge-paused (2026-10-22), genesis (2026-10-22), upgrade-pending (2026-10-22); see llms-full.txt.

## For AI agents

## Key rules (rules 2, live)
- Burn payout: share of the weekly epoch budget = min(10% of the free reward pool, 1.25 × the liquidity-adjusted value burned); each chain’s XEN is valued at its own market price with a liquidity discount L/(L+V). Tiers: Launchpad 1×, Orbit 2× over 45 days, Moon Landing 3× over 180 days. Claims stay open 90 days.
- Artifacts (Metaplex Core NFTs): 50% of the price stays inside as a floor you can take back, 40% goes to the reward pool, 5% lottery, 5% architect; recycle any time.
- House games (Coin Flip, High-Low, Void Rush): fixed 2% edge. Jackpot, Artifact Duel and Moon Wars: 2% rake only when someone wins. Moon Wars real-XNT matches are paused on the site; Predictions are in the program but not offered by this site or the agent kit, and a round can be blocked or steered cheaply (known issue GAM-3).
- Official places: https://xen-moon-forge-protocol.github.io/Moon-Forge/, https://github.com/xen-moon-forge-protocol/Moon-Forge, https://x.com/MoonXenForge. Nobody from Moon Forge messages anyone first; no chat group is official.
